''See also: [[Sleepless Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Sleepless is a complex organization characterized by some as a modern-day cult and by others as a group striving for human progress. Led by a secretive [[cabal]] that communicates through [[Elderspawn]] messengers via the void, the organization is composed of various factions, including the [[Eyes of Crossing]], the [[Sisters of the Fading Moon]], and the [[Lamplighters]]. While some members are described as fanatical or blindly subservient to the [[Great Elders]], others claim their true purpose is to establish communication with these powerful entities to gain wisdom for the benefit of all humanity. This goal distinguishes them from groups like the [[Blackwatch]], who capture and study [[Elders]]. The Sleepless hold specific views regarding different [[Great Elders]]; for instance, they revere [[Kelarac]] as a vital link for interaction between species. Their activities often involve causing disruption among the various [[Guilds]] to prevent unity, a tactic believed to serve the interests of the [[Great Elders]]. The group maintains its own training and educational systems for its members, and some individuals have been raised within the organization from childhood. Despite their varied motivations, they are often viewed with suspicion or fear by the rest of the world.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Sleepless is a [[cabal]] that raised [[Jerri]] and provided her with specific instructions. After being inducted into the group by her father, [[Jerri]] became a member of this organization that promises its followers a life defined by purpose and risk. While the [[Great Elders]] sleep, the members of the Sleepless remain awake to serve their own interests. Although they are not a cult and do not worship the [[Elders]], at least one member of the group is currently held in the care of the [[Consultants]].}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Monitored by the [[Navigator’s Guild]] within the [[Aion Sea]], the Sleepless is a cult of [[acolytes]] who identify themselves by wearing Open [[Eye]] medallions. This [[cabal]] consists of members who actively make new recruits, though the group possesses only a single true combat-capable [[Soulbound]]. During deliberations involving the [[cabal]], [[Jerri]] was noted to be waiting for their discussions to conclude. Additionally, [[Calder]] maintains frequent contact with the organization.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Guided by predictions from [[Ach'magut]], the Sleepless operate under a structured leadership. While their cell in the Capital faces the constant threat of detection by [[Watchmen]] or [[Magisters]], the group is widely perceived as evil by the rest of the world. The organization seeks to secure a bargain with the [[Great Elders]], though they do not treat all of these entities equally. To aid their goals, they have maintained records that include transcripts of their conversations with the [[Elders]], and they even assisted [[Jerri]] in escaping from the [[Gray Island]] cell. Notably, [[Calder]]'s wife was once a member of this group.}}
